data.how_to_load: module load <name>[/<version>]; MPI-built packages appear after `module load openmpi` (or mpich / intel-oneapi-mpi). Compilers: gcc/13.5.0 is the default toolchain of the Spack stack. `module spider <name>` shows how to reach any module.

matches.name: gromacs
matches.usage_card: GROMACS 2026.1: gmx_mpi (openmpi build) and gmx; -cuda module for GPUs. Keep -ntomp x ranks free of large prime factors (22 cores: use 20 or 16), or domain decomposition aborts.

recipes.name: GROMACS (CPU, MPI)
recipes.notes: Use thread/rank counts with small prime factors (16, 20), not 22.
